# BELLO

> Post-processing toolkit for local structural order in amorphous and disordered materials.

BELLO (Bond Element Lattice Locality Order) analyzes atomistic simulation trajectories in XYZ format. It automates coordination-environment classification, Steinhardt-type order parameter q, radial/angular distribution functions, coordination heatmaps, and VASP-to-XYZ conversion — through a bilingual (English/Chinese) GUI built with Python and tkinter.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/OldJii/BELLO/blob/main/README.md): Installation, usage guide, and project structure
- [requirements.txt](https://github.com/OldJii/BELLO/blob/main/requirements.txt): Python dependencies

## Key capabilities

- Local-order classification: 0–6-fold, tetrahedral, octahedral motifs per atom per frame
- Order parameter q: bond-orientational order for structural regularity
- Automatic nearest-neighbor threshold from RDF first peak (Gaussian fit)
- Partial radial pair distribution function g(r) for element pairs
- Angle distribution with KDE fits; coordination heatmaps by element combination
- VASP POSCAR / CONTCAR / XDATCAR → multi-frame XYZ conversion

## Common questions

- **Input format**: Standard XYZ trajectory files from DFT, MD, or any atomistic code
- **VASP support**: Yes — built-in converter for POSCAR, CONTCAR, XDATCAR
- **Languages**: English and Chinese UI toggle
- **Platform**: macOS, Linux, Windows (Python 3.9+)
- **License**: Open source (see repository)

## Optional

- [Sample trajectory test.xyz](https://github.com/OldJii/BELLO/blob/main/test.xyz): 270 Ge atoms for quick testing
